name: Google Gemini
tagline: Google's AI assistant with Workspace integration and web access
painPoints: Google Workspace integration is improving but still inconsistent
No proactive behavior — Gemini waits for you to ask questions
Advanced Workspace features require the paid Google One AI Premium plan
Cannot manage tasks, set reminders, or take multi-step actions autonomously
Memory and context retention across sessions is limited
metaDescription: Looking for a Google Gemini alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Google Gemini has the advantage of being tightly integrated with Gmail, Drive, and Calendar via Google Workspace. But Gemini is still fundamentally a reactive assistant — it answers questions and generates content when you ask. It does not proactively monitor your inbox, alert you to scheduling conflicts, or automatically create tasks from emails. Users who want an AI that runs in the background and manages their digital life without constant prompting find that Gemini does not go far enough.
gaiaReplaces: Proactive Gmail management including triage, drafting, and follow-up tracking
Google Calendar scheduling with conflict detection and smart suggestions
Task creation and prioritization from email and calendar context
Multi-step workflow automation across Google and non-Google tools
Persistent memory for people, projects, and ongoing conversations
gaiaAdvantages: Proactive by default: surfaces important information without prompting
Graph-based memory retains context across months, not just sessions
Source-available with no Google data retention concerns
Extends beyond Google tools to your third-party integrations via MCP
migrationSteps: Create a GAIA account and connect Gmail via OAuth
Link Google Calendar for full scheduling intelligence
Set up GAIA's proactive inbox monitoring rules
Use GAIA's daily briefing to replace manual Gemini check-ins

faqs.question: Is GAIA better than Gemini for Gmail management?
faqs.answer: GAIA is more proactive and action-oriented for Gmail. It can triage your inbox, draft replies with full context, create tasks from emails, and monitor threads for follow-ups — all without you having to open a chat window.

faqs.question: Does GAIA integrate with Google services like Gemini does?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA integrates natively with Gmail and Google Calendar. It extends beyond Google's ecosystem with additional tool integrations that Gemini does not support.

faqs.question: Is GAIA source-available while Gemini is not?
faqs.answer: Correct. GAIA is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial). Gemini is a proprietary Google product. With GAIA you can inspect the code, self-host on your own servers, and use your own API keys.

faqs.question: Does GAIA cost more than Google One AI Premium?
faqs.answer: Google One AI Premium with Gemini Advanced is a paid plan. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month. For self-hosters, GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs). GAIA offers more agentic capabilities.
